quote: People ask me what makes a great skier. It takes the gift; but besides the gift it takes the availability of mind which permits total control of all the elements that lead to victory.
author: Jean-Claude Killy

quote: I will always be someone who wants to do better than others. I love competition.
author: Jean-Claude Killy

quote: Win some, lose some. The object is to win more than you lose, but never give up. Never, ever give up.
author: Jean-Claude Killy

quote: The answer is always there. The problem is to find it. Not to find it is an excuse for not succeeding.
author: Jean-Claude Killy

quote: It doesn't matter if you win the World Cup three, four, five or ten times.
author: Ingemar Stenmark

quote: He was one with his skis. Very reduced margins of error. He annihilated opponents.
I am a beast!
author: Alberto Tomba
notes: La Bomba - 50 World Cup wins, shouted after first big win

quote: I am the new messiah of skiing!
author: Alberto Tomba

quote: Coming from Bologna helped me grow up with a sense of humour and an ability to de-dramatise situations.
author: Alberto Tomba

quote: I regret having retired because those 50 victories could have been many more.
author: Alberto Tomba

quote: I think the most important thing in skiing is you have to be having fun. If you're having fun, then everything else will come easy to you.
author: Lindsey Vonn

quote: When you fall, get right back up.
author: Lindsey Vonn

quote: I want to keep pushing the limits to see what's possible.
author: Lindsey Vonn

quote: When my parents were getting divorced, I just said to myself: Go to sleep, and tomorrow you can go skiing.
author: Lindsey Vonn

quote: You can create your own miracle, but you do it by never looking past all the little steps along the way.
author: Mikaela Shiffrin

quote: It's not about being the best. It's about being better than you were yesterday.
author: Mikaela Shiffrin

quote: When I get back on snow, it's almost like I travel back in time to that youthful, 6-year-old feeling where nothing else matters.
author: Mikaela Shiffrin

quote: A pair of skis are the ultimate transportation to freedom.
author: Warren Miller

quote: If you don't do it this year, you will be one year older when you do.
author: Warren Miller

quote: Skiing is the best way in the world to waste time.
author: Glen Plake

quote: Skis are not just pieces of wood, steel and fiberglass. They are tools for escape, a medium for personal expression.
author: Glen Plake

quote: A person should have wings to carry them where their dreams go, but sometimes a pair of skis makes a good substitute.
author: Hans Gmoser

quote: Life is like skiing. The goal is not to get to the bottom of the hill. It's to have a bunch of good runs before the sun sets.
author: Seth Godin

quote: For me, personally, skiing holds everything. It removes the machinery and puts you one step closer to the elements.
author: Robert Redford

quote: There is no such thing as too much snow.
author: Doug Coombs

quote: You are one with your skis and nature. This develops not only the body but the soul as well.
author: Fridtjof Nansen

quote: It's better to go skiing and think of God than go to church and think of sport.
author: Fridtjof Nansen

quote: Skating was the vessel into which I could pour my heart and soul.
author: Peggy Fleming

quote: Figure skating is a mixture of art and sport.
author: Katarina Witt

quote: When I go out on the ice, I just think about my skating. I forget it is a competition.
author: Katarina Witt

quote: I started to figure skate at age five, and the first thing my coach taught me was how to fall.
author: Michelle Kwan

quote: Literally falling on the ice and having to pick yourself up in front of thousands of people is not easy. You learn to pick yourself back up.
author: Michelle Kwan

quote: Winning is not about how many medals you get—it's about accomplishing goals and just being the best you can be.
author: Michelle Kwan

quote: When I was younger, I always dreamed of being a legend, to be remembered in figure skating.
author: Michelle Kwan

quote: Love your sport. Never do it to please someone else; it has to be yours.
author: Michelle Kwan

quote: I just try to touch people's hearts through skating, so they're not just witnessing a performance, they're feeling it.
author: Scott Hamilton

quote: Everything that I've been able to accomplish in skating and life has come out of adversity and perseverance.
author: Scott Hamilton

quote: Without strength and courage it's really hard to perform at the highest levels. You're alone on the ice with just seven minutes to prove yourself.
author: Scott Hamilton

quote: I never feel like a champion. I'm always a challenger.
author: Yuzuru Hanyu

quote: The driving force for growth is to have an open heart.
author: Yuzuru Hanyu

quote: Even if I don't do well in a competition, my motivation goes up 100% after a failure.
author: Yuzuru Hanyu

quote: In skating I can use all languages, for all the people.
author: Yuzuru Hanyu

quote: It's everything for me. Without figure skating, I am nothing.
author: Evgeni Plushenko

quote: The biggest lesson has been that there are no shortcuts. It's just a lot of hard work and sacrifice to get what you want.
author: Tessa Virtue

quote: A figure skater is not just a figure skater who does great jumps. He is an artist on ice.
author: Alexei Yagudin

quote: Ole Einar Bjørndalen is one of the greatest of all time. He is a true Olympian and a role model for young athletes around the world.
author: Thomas Bach
notes: IOC President on the King of Biathlon

quote: He raised professional standards for the benefit of everyone. The media coverage we enjoy today would not have been possible without him.
author: Martin Fourcade

quote: Silver was like gold for me because it has been a long time since I was on the podium.
author: Ole Einar Bjørndalen

quote: I am proud I achieved what I did, proud I discovered myself along that journey and just a beautiful way to finish it.
author: Martin Fourcade

quote: Martin pushed everyone at the start line to be a better biathlete.
author: Johannes Thingnes Boe

quote: Very few athletes know what burden one carries throughout the season to end it victorious. It is really, really hard.
author: Johannes Thingnes Boe

quote: Many years of hard work have gone into magical moments like this.
author: Martin Fourcade

quote: You miss 100% of the shots you don't take.
author: Wayne Gretzky
notes: The most famous sports quote ever

quote: A good hockey player plays where the puck is. A great hockey player plays where the puck is going to be.
author: Wayne Gretzky

quote: I skate to where the puck is going to be, not where it has been.
author: Wayne Gretzky

quote: The highest compliment that you can pay me is to say that I work hard every day, that I never dog it.
author: Wayne Gretzky

quote: When you win, say nothing. When you lose, say less.
author: Wayne Gretzky

quote: I wasn't naturally gifted in terms of size and speed; everything I did in hockey I worked for.
author: Wayne Gretzky

quote: The day I stop giving is the day I stop receiving. The day I stop learning is the day I stop growing.
author: Wayne Gretzky

quote: Hockey is a unique sport in the sense that you need each and every guy helping each other and pulling in the same direction.
author: Wayne Gretzky

quote: No matter who you are, we're creatures of habit. The better your habits are, the better they will be in pressure situations.
author: Wayne Gretzky

quote: Great moments are born from great opportunity.
author: Herb Brooks

quote: The legs feed the wolf.
author: Herb Brooks

quote: It's incredible when I look back and see what I've done.
author: Marit Bjorgen
notes: Most decorated Winter Olympian ever (15 medals)

quote: I have been lucky to have had the mental strength to be able to give it my all.
author: Marit Bjorgen

quote: It's difficult to see yourself as a legend. Bjørn Daehlie is really someone I have admired since I was a kid.
author: Marit Bjorgen

quote: Being the most successful Winter Games athlete is like a dream come true for me.
author: Marit Bjorgen

quote: Some people attach snowboards to their feet, very few attach them to their souls.
author: Shaun White

quote: I didn't set out to beat the world; I just set out to do my absolute best.
author: Shaun White

quote: You take a crash, you get back up and next time you succeed and that's a great feeling.
author: Shaun White

quote: What does it mean to be a snowboarder? It's about pushing yourself to try new things and do the unexpected.
author: Shaun White

quote: Every time I've had a bad performance at an event, I've come back more determined and focused.
author: Shaun White

quote: To me, snowboarding is really an art form. Every snowboarder has her own style, and that makes them stand out.
author: Chloe Kim

quote: Stay true to your passion.
author: Chloe Kim

quote: I wouldn't even call snowboarding a sport. For me, it's just a way of life.
author: Travis Rice

quote: There are no rules in snowboarding.
author: Amy Purdy

quote: The attraction of snowboarding is the freedom it gives you. With a snowboard on your feet, the sky's the limit.
author: Jeremy Jones

quote: Feel the rhythm! Feel the rhyme! Get on up, it's bobsled time!
author: Cool Runnings

quote: A gold medal is a wonderful thing. But if you're not enough without it, you'll never be enough with it.
author: Irv Blitzer (Cool Runnings)

quote: I'm standing on the shoulders of giants and trying to inspire the next generation.
author: Kelly Curtis

quote: Those guys have earned the right to walk into that stadium and wave their nation's flag. That's the single greatest honor an athlete can ever have.
author: Irv Blitzer (Cool Runnings)

quote: When you're a professional athlete in a sport that sucks as much as speed skating sucks, you've got to find a way to make it suck a little less.
author: Nils van der Poel

quote: I love the sport, more than most things, but if you want to keep loving it, you have to work for it. It's like a relationship.
author: Nils van der Poel

quote: Pressure is a privilege.
author: Billie Jean King

quote: Champions aren't made in the gym. Champions are made from something they have deep inside them—a desire, a dream, a vision.
author: Muhammad Ali

quote: Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.
author: Winston Churchill

quote: Hard work beats talent when talent doesn't work hard.
author: Tim Notke

quote: The more difficult the victory, the greater the happiness in winning.
author: Pelé

quote: It's not the will to win that matters—everyone has that. It's the will to prepare to win that matters.
author: Bear Bryant

quote: The mountains are calling, and I must go.
author: John Muir

quote: Powder snow skiing is not fun. It's life, fully lived, life lived in a blaze of reality.
author: Dolores LaChapelle

quote: In the mountains, time moves differently.
Snow is not just frozen water. It's a chance to start fresh.
Skiing is a dance, and the mountain always leads.
The sound of blades on ice is the heartbeat of passion.
White lips, pale face, breathing in the snowflakes.
Great things are not done by impulse, but by a series of small things brought together.
author: Vincent van Gogh

quote: The secret of getting ahead is getting started.
author: Mark Twain

quote: Every champion was once a contender who refused to give up.
author: Rocky Balboa

quote: Biathlon: where your heart rate is 180 and you have to hit a target the size of a golf ball.
In ski jumping, athletes reach speeds of 95 km/h before takeoff.
A bobsled team experiences up to 5G of force in the turns.
Speed skaters can reach 60 km/h on the ice.
Figure skaters spin at up to 6 revolutions per second.
The downhill course at Kitzbühel drops 862 meters in under 2 minutes.
Cross-country skiers have the highest VO2 max of any athletes—some exceed 90 ml/kg/min.
